summary: No more fixed posting times. From 6 AM Arizona, the specialist makes and posts a Reel every hour until the day has five posts on Instagram, and the posts you approve count toward the five. A Reel that fails a check is simply followed by the next hour's, in the next format, up to 10 tries a day.
frontend: Schedule shows today's count (for example 2 of 5 posted), what it's making now or why it stopped, and how many tries it has used, instead of five fixed times.
Approve puts a post at the next free hour (20 past), from 6 AM to 9 PM.
other: reels.yml runs at :03 past every hour from 6 AM to 9 PM; a run that finds five already posted stops in a minute.
The mix rotates explainer, satisfying, ad, explainer, satisfying, moving on after a failed one so one format can't hold up the day.
Hitta's answers know the new schedule.
